summary: Tested AYMAFIN iteration 3 (refactor + soft delete + admin polish + legacy PDF bug). Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASS (extended iter2 file: added TestLegacyPdf class, updated TestAdmin for soft-delete/restore semantics, updated TestBankPdf to assert X-Bank-Used + X-Lang-Used response headers, updated TestAdmin stats for deleted_users key). Frontend: admin page polish all verified — search filter (typing 'admin' narrows 14→1), sortable column headers (clicking name asc→desc with arrow icon), deleted toggle, delete modal opens via admin-delete-{id} → cancel/confirm testids, refresh button reloads, avatars/role chips/pending tag rendered, self-row delete button disabled. Legacy PDF bug confirmed FIXED (synthetic legacy snapshot with [{title,detail}] recommendations rendered as valid 4kb+ %PDF, no 500). Soft-delete round-trip verified: DELETE returns soft_deleted_at, user disappears from default GET /api/admin/users, appears under ?include_deleted=true with deleted_at field, deleted user gets 401 on login, restore re-enables login, double-delete returns 400, double-restore returns 400, self-delete returns 400.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_utils.get_current_user filters deleted_at — verified deleted users get 401 on login + on /me. Good.
admin.py uses single $lookup pipeline replacing N+1 count_documents — verified response shape unchanged and admin/users still returns id/email/business/reports_count/chats_count/deleted_at correctly.
pdf_builder._resolve_reco supports both new {key,params} and legacy {title,detail} — confirmed via TestLegacyPdf test (legacy snapshot mutated directly in mongo, PDF renders fine).
reports.py exposes X-Bank-Used + X-Lang-Used headers and CORS expose_headers includes them in app.py — verified header values match resolved bank/lang (including fallback to generic when invalid).
Soft-delete cascades to businesses + reports collections via {deleted_at, deleted_by} fields. Restore $unsets these. Atomic via update_many — good.

Minor: Admin.jsx uses inline event handlers (toggleSort, onClick={() => setShowDeleted(...)}) which create new function instances on each render. For a 14-row table this is negligible, but if the table grows to 1000+ rows consider memoizing with useCallback.
Minor: server.py is now a 5-line shim per spec — clean refactor. Routers are under 100 lines each. Good split.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestLegacyPdf with synthetic legacy-snapshot mongo write; updated TestAdmin.test_admin_delete_user_cascades for soft-delete + restore round-trip + double-delete 400; updated TestAdmin.test_admin_stats_admin_ok to assert deleted_users key; updated TestBankPdf.test_pdf_bna_fr + test_pdf_invalid_bank_falls_back to assert X-Bank-Used + X-Lang-Used headers — 31 tests total, all green)

All 31 tests green. TestLegacyPdf writes directly to mongo via config.db (asyncio.run) to inject a legacy {title,detail} snapshot.
